title: Find the Second Largest
description: Return the second-largest distinct number, or None when fewer than two distinct values exist.

off_by_one: The largest value is not the requested result.
Keep track of distinct positions in the descending order.
Duplicates should not create a new rank.
Trace two distinct values, then repeat the largest value.
unhandled_short_input: There may be fewer than two distinct choices.
Check how many distinct values are available before selecting a rank.
An empty list and a list with one value need the documented empty result.
Trace empty, one-value, equal-value, and two-value inputs.
boundary_comparison: Equality matters when deciding whether a value creates a new rank.
Compare repeated values with genuinely smaller values.
The second rank must be distinct from the first.
Try two equal values and then two different values.

explanations.empty_list: There is no second distinct value in an empty input.
explanations.short_input: Fewer than two distinct values cannot produce a second-largest result.
explanations.exact_boundary: Equal values share one rank and should not count twice.
explanations.normal: Choose the largest value after excluding the largest distinct value.
